decision.observation: The goose stands on the path south of the closed back gate; the boot is on the grass to the right. The latch/tap fittings on the right post only sparkle when beaked. The path visible beyond the gate continues north.
decision.hypothesis: The back gate may not be openable by the goose at all. The pond at the map's north edge has never been crossed — the goose can swim, and its far side may hold the route onward.
decision.memory: Route plan: gate → SW to bicycle fork → west along north bank → pond; try swimming north across the water.
